scope: Independent numeric/result-cell inventory for the three released ScienceWorld numbers CSVs, algebraic replay of currently unmapped trend statistics, ARC mapper coverage classification, and static localization of the documented ScienceWorld train/eval overlap confound. This is retrospective byte-level audit only, not original hosted-model execution attestation.

scienceworld_publication_cell_inventory.definition: Numeric/result cells in the three released ScienceWorld numbers CSVs, excluding identity/text columns. This inventory is intentionally scoped to those three CSVs and must not be generalized to the whole paper.

eval_8methods_success_and_rawscore_csv.raw_k16_note: raw_k16 is not mapped by sciworld_eval; the other 29 rows contribute only their success-count cell.

aggregate.interpretation: 57/309 is direct mapper coverage for these three ScienceWorld CSVs only. It is not a paper-wide verification fraction. Unmapped does not mean unreproducible: many omitted cells are deterministic reductions of released rows or other released cells.

cochran_armitage.inputs: four ordered groups N=100,200,300,400; n=50 each; scores 1,2,3,4; published success counts
cochran_armitage.formula_scope: standard score trend statistic using p*(1-p)*sum n_i*(x_i-xbar)^2 without finite-population correction; two-sided normal p-value
cochran_armitage.qc: All seven z and seven p cells round to the released table values.

raw_score_linear_slope.inputs: released raw means at N=100,200,300,400; x=1,2,3,4, so OLS slope is per 100 stream steps
raw_score_linear_slope.qc: All seven slopes round to the released table values. This validates table-internal arithmetic, not the row provenance of the raw means.

scienceworld_denominator_refinement.documented_behavior: Current results/README.md explicitly distinguishes n_tasks from n_valid, states ScienceWorld has 288/1500 error/skipped non-outcomes, states ScienceWorld numbers/* uses n_tasks for displayed success rates, gives langmem N100 as 33/50=66% versus 33/44=75% valid-only, and states the trend significance used n=50.
scienceworld_denominator_refinement.verifier_behavior: verify_numbers.py loads only valid rows but the ScienceWorld mappers check success counts only. Therefore green mapper checks do not directly attest the displayed denominator/rate or the n=50 trend-test semantics, even though current documentation discloses them.
scienceworld_denominator_refinement.interpretation: This is no longer an undocumented-denominator claim. It remains a coverage-closure issue because the official checker does not bind the displayed rate/denominator or trend statistics.

arc_stream_self_eval.outcome_metric_coverage: directly mapped for every released cell where the metric exists

arc_200task_stream.outcome_metric_coverage: directly mapped for every released cell

arc_coverage_classification.transport_child: Per-example got/expected grading transcripts remain packed only in .jsonl.gz trajectories on the tested public surface. The scheduled-Chat UTF-8 repository route can bind blob identities but not inspect those gzip payloads, so row-success-to-grader-output verification remains unresolved despite strong aggregate coverage.

scienceworld_overlap_child.published_archive_correction: archive-SUMMARY.md states the earlier train/eval-zero-overlap claim was wrong under task_description matching: the 101 successful memory-building pool trajectories include 10 trajectories matching eval instances: 6 test-conductivity-of-unknown-substances, 2 change-state, 2 grow-plant. raw_k16 was filtered and rerun, but retrieval-memory arms were built from the overlapping stream.
scienceworld_overlap_child.public_eval_manifest: plan_eval_10fam.json fixes 50 tasks across 10 families, five per family, with immutable game_idx entries.
scienceworld_overlap_child.unresolved_static_reanalysis: The archive itself states that whether the langmem collapse remains significant after excluding overlapping eval instances has not been evaluated. Exact overlap eval identities have not yet been bound in this run. Once bound from public task descriptions, released per-task outcomes are sufficient in principle to recompute filtered checkpoint successes and the Cochran-Armitage z/p without rerunning the model.
scienceworld_overlap_child.priority: highest-value next child because it directly tests a headline causal/statistical conclusion using already released static evidence

protocol_067_assessment.status: falsifies exhaustive-verifier-coverage wording for ScienceWorld but reveals a tooling/coverage-closure gap more than a missing-data gap
protocol_067_assessment.safe_claim: The public 675-cell green result attests 675 mapper-defined checks. It is not an independently complete inventory of all publication numeric cells.

strong_scope_limited_mechanisms: ScienceWorld table-internal static replay of all released Cochran-Armitage z/p and raw-score slope cells from released table inputs.
ARC aggregate outcome metric checking for n_rows, n_success, mean and std from plain committed rows.
